summary: Framework RL doanh nghiệp cho hậu-training LLM và VLM, hỗ trợ căn chỉnh và tinh chỉnh quy mô mở.
usecases: Post-training alignment of enterprise LLMs using custom reward models
Fine-tuning VLMs for domain-specific tasks via reinforcement learning
Scalable pipeline for LLM agent training and evaluation
ideas: Combine with human-in-the-loop feedback for continuous LLM improvement
Enable custom RL pipelines for proprietary foundation model fine-tuning
Integrate with RAG systems to create domain-adaptive AI agents
